header:
Is 0% utilization
really the best score?

lines.text: Myth: 0% credit utilization gets you the highest score.
lines.say: Myth: zero percent credit utilization gets you the highest score.

lines.text: Utilization is your reported card balances divided by your limits.
lines.say: Utilization is your reported card balances divided by your limits.

lines.text: myFICO says amounts owed make up about 30% of a FICO Score.
lines.say: myFICO says amounts owed make up about thirty percent of a FICO Score.

lines.text: The twist: myFICO says all cards at $0 can score slightly lower than a small balance, like 3%, since it can look unused.
lines.say: The twist: myFICO says all cards at zero dollars can score slightly lower than a small balance, like three percent, since it can look unused.

lines.text: People with 800+ scores average about 7%, per Experian's 2026 data.
lines.say: People with eight hundred plus scores average about seven percent, per Experian's twenty twenty-six data.

lines.text: Our math: $150 of a $5,000 limit is 3%. Paid in full: $0 interest.
lines.say: Our math: a hundred fifty dollars of a five thousand dollar limit is three percent. Paid in full: zero dollars interest.

lines.text: FICO's US average, each April: 706 in 2019, a record 718 in 2023, 715 in 2025.
lines.say: FICO's US average, each April: seven oh six in twenty nineteen, a record seven eighteen in twenty twenty-three, seven fifteen in twenty twenty-five.

lines.text: So 0% versus low single digits is a small gap, and you never need to carry interest.
lines.say: So zero versus low single digits is a small gap, and you never need to carry interest.

post.title: Does 0% credit utilization give you the best score?
post.ig:
Myth: 0% credit utilization gets you the highest score.
myFICO says amounts owed make up about 30% of a FICO Score.
myFICO also says every card reporting $0 can score slightly lower than a small reported balance, because it can look like no active use.
People with 800+ FICO Scores average about 7% utilization (myFICO; Experian 2026 data).
The gap is small, and you never need to carry interest: a small balance paid in full costs $0.
Sources: myFICO, FICO, Experian.
